description:
Limited Item
In the darkest of castles, any light is a precious commodity.
All Survivors start the Trial with a
Candelabra
held in hand.
Additional
Candelabras
may be found in
Chests
located in the environment.
The
Auras
of all
Candelabras
placed in the environment are revealed to all Survivors in
white
at all times.
Pushes back the Fog as a passive effect when held.
Press and hold the
Use Item button
while holding the
Candelabra
to benefit from the following effects:
90 Charges
.
The Aura of the nearest incomplete
Generator
is revealed to you.
The
Survivor Activity HUD
is displayed to you, but without any visible Progression.
Place the
Candelabra
on top of a
Generator
to benefit from the following effects:
The Aura of that
Generator
is revealed to all Survivors within
32 metres
.
Completing that
Generator
causes it to
suppress
the Killer's ability to read the Auras of all remaining incomplete
Generators
for
15 seconds
or until the
Candelabra
is removed from it by any means.
Can be destroyed by the Killer when placed on
Generators
.
The
Candelabra
is only available for use in the
Lights Out - Castlevania
Modifier Event.
Limited Items
are consumed on use.
They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The
Entity
upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item

Supply Cases
when facing
The
Singularity
.
The
Auras
of
Supply Cases
are visible when within
28 metres
:
Takes
100 Charges
to be printed.
Passive printing charges at a rate of
+1 c/s
, but is limited to
97 Charges
, requiring the final
3 Charges
to be actively printed by a Survivor.
Active printing charges at a rate of
+4 c/s
while a Survivor interacts with the
Supply Case
.
Takes
2.5 seconds
to charge.
Incurs a
-10%
Hindered
Status Effect
while charging and holding.
Has an
Area of Effect
of
10 metres
.
Removes
Temporal Slipstream
from anyone within its
Area of Effect
upon detonation.
The
Auras
of other
Slipstreamed Survivors
are revealed to you in
yellow
when within the
Area of Effect
.
Disables all
Biopods
within the
Area of Effect
for
45 seconds
upon detonation and grants immunity to
Temporal Slipstream
for
1 second
.
Limited Items
are consumed on use.
They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The
Entity
upon exiting the Trial.

when it is inside the Tunnels while carrying the
Turret

-35%
Hindered
Status Effect

Exhausted
and
Incapacitated
Status Effects
, while carrying the

Crawler Mode
The Xenomorph

30 seconds
